attribute_information.Ash: Percentage of ash (mineral content) in the sample
attribute_information.AshCV: Coefficient of variation of ash percentage across replicate samples
attribute_information.AshedWeight: Weight of inorganic residue remaining after ashing the dried sample (g)
attribute_information.AvgAsh: Average ash percentage calculated from replicate samples
attribute_information.AvgDM: Average dry matter percentage calculated from replicate samples
attribute_information.Crucible: Identification number of the crucible used for drying and ashing the sample
attribute_information.CrucibleWeight: Weight of the empty crucible before adding the sample (g)
attribute_information.DM: Percentage of dry matter in the sample calculated from wet and dried weights
attribute_information.DMCV: Coefficient of variation of dry matter percentage across replicates
attribute_information.DriedWeight: Weight of the tissue sample after oven drying (g)
attribute_information.Sample: Unique identifier assigned to each tissue sample
attribute_information.SampleWeight: Weight of the fresh tissue sample before drying (g)

meta.description: This dataset contains laboratory measurements of dry matter and ash content from tissue samples collected from late-gestation sows. Samples include feed, carcass, viscera, uterus, placenta, fetus, and mammary glands.Each sample includes measurements used to calculate dry matter percentage and ash percentage.
meta.name: Sow Nutrition and Fetal Development Dataset
